title: NovaCorp Employee Separation & Termination Procedures
content:
NovaCorp Employee Separation and Termination Procedures — HR Internal Document

1. TYPES OF SEPARATION
1.1 Voluntary Resignation: Employee initiates separation. Standard notice period is 2 weeks; senior roles (L4 and above) require 4 weeks.
1.2 Involuntary Termination for Performance: Following a documented Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) of at least 60 days with failure to meet objectives.
1.3 Involuntary Termination for Conduct: Immediate termination for gross misconduct including fraud, violence, harassment, theft, and data breach. HR and Legal must approve.
1.4 Layoff or Reduction in Force: Reduction due to business conditions. Requires VP-level approval and legal review. Severance applicable.
1.5 Retirement: Standard retirement at or after age 65. Phased retirement available with VP approval.

2. NOTICE AND SEVERANCE
Layoffs: 1 week per year of service, minimum 2 weeks, maximum 26 weeks. Performance terminations: 2 weeks pay in lieu of notice. Resignation: No severance unless agreed. Gross misconduct: No notice, no severance.

3. OFFBOARDING CHECKLIST
- IT access revoked within 2 hours of notification
- Physical access badges collected at time of notification
- Final paycheck issued per jurisdiction requirements
- COBRA benefits paperwork provided within 3 days
- Company property returned: laptop, phone, credit card, access cards
- Separation agreement signed and processed if applicable
- Exit interview conducted by HR (voluntary)

4. DOCUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS
All terminations must have: written documentation of reason, manager sign-off, HR review, and Legal sign-off for involuntary terminations. Records retained for 7 years.

5. REHIRE ELIGIBILITY
Voluntary leavers in good standing: eligible for rehire after 6 months. Performance terminations: eligible for rehire after 2 years at manager discretion. Gross misconduct: permanent ineligibility.
